source_question: Which Method does this subject depend on or employ?
source_effect: Records Method dependency without implying conformance, realization, or success.

independent_meaning.state_parameter: W: independently defined typed semantic world and owned catalogs
common_constraints: Exact kind/source definition and approved meaning revision.
Exact source/target node kinds and revisions match one declared ordered pair.
Every required qualifier has its independently defined typed interpretation; closed qualifier object has no extra field.
Primary witness, subject, target, context, scope, source snapshot, epoch and time domain agree with the complete frame.
The selected evidence and provenance policy establishes the claimed recorded/as-of/executed/observed posture; missing authenticity is not manufactured.
kind_specific_constraints: w.subject = s and w.method = t; usage_role selects the owned dependency/employment posture.
Method specification and its exact version remain distinct from implementation and successful execution.

qualifiers.exact_role: record.usage_role: exact relation-specific owned role/posture/purpose code, interpreted for this ordered endpoint pair
qualifiers.interpretation: Define the relation-specific role/code domain and its effect on meaning; membership in a code catalog is not authority, execution or success.
qualifiers.success_condition: The exact raw token maps through the owner-selected revisioned catalog to this typed role; all record, endpoint and frame constraints in Meaning hold.

operational_effect.meaning: Record the method dependency/use posture without conformance, realization, validation or achievement.
operational_effect.record_delta: Append one exact immutable witnessed relation record, or idempotently retain an identical existing revision; same revision with different content is refused.
operational_effect.recording_preservation: Recording a relation preserves authority roots, ownership, identity classes, admissions and runtime/external state. A separately authorized execution can change only its approved domain envelope.
operational_effect.execution_boundary: A record append does not implement its source witness's execution. Materialization requires evidence of a completed authorized atomic application; no standalone relation row proves it.

forbidden_conclusions.definition: An admissible exact conformance assessment establishes every applicable target criterion in scope.

forbidden_conclusions.context_rule: Endpoint anchors come from this exact primary witness. Any extra variables are existential typed references in the independently owned catalog and exact frame; none is supplied as an asserted conclusion flag.
forbidden_conclusions.scope: Non-entailment in the exact pinned relation/source theory; no universal falsity claim.

source_refinement_contract: Under exact owned catalog/frame well-formedness, decoding and resolution of raw source fields yields a iff the independently specified source constraints denote Meaning_K38(W,a). The decoder/checker must not define that source predicate.
proof_contract: Prove the independent meaning has a valid positive model.
Prove each exact qualifier mapping and checker/meaning equivalence.
Prove declared record effect and any required execution/closure preservation.
Check each kind-scoped non-entailment countermodel under the complete pinned theory.
Account for all declared ordered pairs and prove role-sensitive branches; one positive example per kind is insufficient.
